net._note: Netted within one scale and one bearer only. Costs per tonne on an EU producer and grants awarded to a developer are different units on different balance sheets and are never summed together.

measures.duty: Build Union capacity towards extracting 10%, processing 40% and recycling 25% of the Union's annual consumption of each strategic raw material by 2030.

plain.title: Europe sets itself capacity goals for its own raw materials
plain.sentence: By 2030 the Union is to be able to extract, process and recycle set shares of the strategic raw materials it consumes each year, rather than buying all of them from outside.

missing: no money model applies to this measure

edges.bottleneck_name: Cell capacity without the materials behind it
edges.note: The benchmark that answers this constraint directly: extraction, processing and recycling capacity inside the Union for each strategic raw material, which is what a cathode works needs upstream of it. It is a benchmark on the Union rather than a duty on anybody's factory, and it is dated.

evidence.quote: Build Union capacity towards extracting 10%, processing 40% and recycling 25% of the Union's annual consumption of each strategic raw material by 2030.

measures.duty: Meet an EU fleet-wide target of a 100% reduction on the 2021 baseline for new passenger cars from 2035.

plain.title: New cars sold in Europe have to be zero-emission
plain.sentence: From 2035 a new passenger car sold in the Union may emit no CO2 where it is driven, which at fleet scale means the car carries a battery.

missing: no money model applies to this measure

edges.bottleneck_name: Committing capacity against uncertain vehicle demand
edges.note: The one provision that removes the demand question rather than answering it: a 100% reduction on the tailpipe measure means a new car sold in the Union carries a battery, so a factory sanctioned against it is sanctioned against a legal deadline rather than against a forecast.

evidence.quote: Meet an EU fleet-wide target of a 100% reduction on the 2021 baseline for new passenger cars from 2035.

measures.when: From entry into force; thresholds phase in at 1/3/4/6 years after entry into force depending on technology
measures.duty: Apply the Union-origin requirements laid down in the new Annex II when procuring listed net-zero technologies (battery storage, solar PV, heat pumps, wind, nuclear).

plain.title: Public contracts for battery storage must buy European
plain.sentence: Public buyers procuring battery storage have to apply the Union-origin requirements the act sets out for it, so part of the demand is closed to a cell made elsewhere.

missing: no money model applies to this measure

edges.note: The only provision in the register that puts an origin requirement on battery storage by name, on the buying side. It does not lower a European cost per kWh; it removes part of the demand a cheaper imported cell can compete for.

evidence.quote: Apply the Union-origin requirements laid down in the new Annex II when procuring listed net-zero technologies (battery storage, solar PV, heat pumps, wind, nuclear).

measures.duty: Diversify imports so that no single third country supplies more than 65% of the Union's annual consumption of any strategic raw material by 2030.

plain.title: No single country may supply most of a strategic material
plain.sentence: By 2030 the Union's yearly consumption of each strategic raw material is to come from several countries, with no one of them above the share the act sets.

missing: no money model applies to this measure

edges.bottleneck_name: Cell capacity without the materials behind it
edges.note: The other half of the same article, and the one that concedes the material will still be imported: it caps how much of it may come from any one country rather than moving the supply into Europe.

evidence.quote: Diversify imports so that no single third country supplies more than 65% of the Union's annual consumption of any strategic raw material by 2030.

measures.duty: File a Strategic Project application carrying ten items: evidence against the criteria, a UN Framework Classification, a permitting timetable, a public-acceptance plan, ownership and control information, a business plan, a jobs and skills estimate, a post-exploitation environmental restoration plan, an alternative-locations assessment in protected areas, and an indigenous-peoples consultation plan.

plain.title: Raw material projects can apply for strategic status
plain.sentence: A raw materials project can apply to be recognised as strategic, which brings faster permitting and easier access to finance, by filing evidence against the criteria together with a business plan, a timetable and environmental and consultation plans.

missing: no money model applies to this measure

edges.bottleneck_name: Cell capacity without the materials behind it
edges.note: The route by which a particular materials project gets built: recognition brings shortened permitting and access to finance to the works that would sit upstream of these sites.

evidence.quote: File a Strategic Project application carrying ten items: evidence against the criteria, a UN Framework Classification, a permitting timetable, a public-acceptance plan, ownership and control information, a business plan, a jobs and skills estimate, a post-exploitation environmental restoration plan, an alternative-locations assessment in protected areas, and an indigenous-peoples consultation plan.

plain.title: EU grants for building battery factories
plain.sentence: The Innovation Fund, financed by auctioning carbon allowances, has awarded grants to European cell works through its first battery call, and published no figure for what any one of them received.

missing: no money model applies to this measure

edges.bottleneck_name: Ramping a cell line to yield
edges.note: The register reaches the financial deadline on this constraint and not the constraint itself: Innovation Fund money is capital during the interval between commissioning and yield, and three of the sites here hold a grant from its first Battery Call. Nothing in the register reaches scrap rates.

evidence.quote: Grants and other support (e.g. blended finance) from the Innovation Fund, financed by auctioning 200 million allowances from reduced free allocation, are available via open competitive calls for projects scaling up low-/zero-carbon and carbon-negative products, processes and technologies across all Member States.

measures.when: In force; applies to each calendar year
measures.duty: Pay an excess emissions premium of EUR 95 per gram per kilometre of exceedance, multiplied by the number of newly registered vehicles.

plain.title: Carmakers pay for every gram they are over their target
plain.sentence: A carmaker whose fleet exceeds its target pays a premium for each gram per kilometre of the excess on every vehicle it registered, which is what makes the target a purchasing decision rather than an ambition.

missing: no money model applies to this measure

edges.bottleneck_name: Committing capacity against uncertain vehicle demand
edges.note: The price of missing the target, which is what turns it from an aspiration into a procurement decision. It is money out of a carmaker rather than money into a cell maker, which is why it is weighted below the targets it enforces.

evidence.quote: Pay an excess emissions premium of EUR 95 per gram per kilometre of exceedance, multiplied by the number of newly registered vehicles.

measures.duty: Meet an EU fleet-wide target of a 55% reduction on the 2021 baseline for new passenger cars, and 50% for new light commercial vehicles.

plain.title: Carmakers must halve the emissions of the cars they sell
plain.sentence: From 2030 the average new car sold in the Union has to cut its emissions by more than half against the baseline year, with new vans close behind, which is the demand a factory being built today supplies.

missing: no money model applies to this measure

edges.bottleneck_name: Committing capacity against uncertain vehicle demand
edges.note: The step before it, and the one inside the horizon of a factory being built now — the fleet has to be halfway there five years before the full target bites.

evidence.quote: Meet an EU fleet-wide target of a 55% reduction on the 2021 baseline for new passenger cars, and 50% for new light commercial vehicles.
